summary: Layer 1B expanded the US-listed universe for grid-stability and high-voltage power-quality components. The best direct underfollowed US-listed exposure found in this pass is AMSC for dynamic reactive compensation, power-quality systems, and grid interconnection. PLPC is a second-order transmission-hardware beneficiary tied to physical grid buildout rather than HVDC reactors specifically. HMDPF is an OTC-accessible Canadian magnetics / dry-type transformer / power-quality supplier, relevant to the magnetics and power-conditioning branch but not a pure HVDC reactor play. HUBB is included only as a reference leader because it has direct utility transmission, substation, grid protection and controls exposure, but its size and breadth dilute chokepoint purity. No buy/sell view is implied.
